summary: Iteration 2 focused testing of NEW features: Stripe paid consultation (Flow B sandbox), Yahoo Finance live market data, newsletter subscribe + admin subscribers view, real client photos and contact details, plus light regression on admin & UI. Added new backend suite test_new_features.py (10 tests, all pass). Backend total run: 10/10 pass for new features (existing 25/25 from iteration_1 already verified). Frontend E2E via external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: hero-portrait, about-image, login-side image all load (naturalWidth 1333 ≠ broken); contact-email/phone/whatsapp links have correct hrefs (mailto:sudarshan@karweers.com, tel:+917208998944, wa.me/917208998944); Market Pulse shows LIVE badge and 8 real Yahoo Finance tiles; Newsletter signup returns success toast; Consultation packages (discovery/strategy/deepdive) render, selecting Strategy + filling name/email + clicking Reserve & Pay navigates to checkout.stripe.com (verified real Stripe test URL cs_test_...); Admin Dashboard shows Newsletter Subscribers stat (4 rows), subscribers tab lists emails, Leads tab shows package · $amount for paid bookings and status dropdown includes payment_pending + paid options. No blocking bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/consultations/{cid} still accepts arbitrary status strings (query param, no Pydantic Literal). Adding 'paid'/'payment_pending' to the UI is fine, but backend should validate the enum to prevent bad states.
PaymentSuccess polls max 8 times × 2s = 16s. For slower Stripe confirmations users may hit the 'Still processing' state. Consider raising MAX_TRIES to 15 or exponential backoff.

/api/payments/checkout uses request.base_url for webhook_url which may not match the public URL in a proxy setup (Kubernetes ingress). This works today but could bite in prod — prefer an explicit PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var.
MarketPulse falls back silently to static benchmarks when Yahoo is empty (no error surfaced). This is acceptable UX but a small logger.warning on backend when live data is empty would help ops.
STRIPE_API_KEY is 'sk_test_emergent' (shared sandbox). Fine for now, but claimable sandbox creation failed with 'country not supported: IN' per prior note — will need real key at go-live.
CORS still uses '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for cookie-based auth. Non-issue today since frontend uses Bearer, but worth cleaning up.
Slug generation still lacks retry-on-collision on IntegrityError (very low probability).

To fully verify PaymentSuccess UI you'd need to drive the Stripe test page (email → 4242 4242 4242 4242 → any expiry/CVC). Yahoo Finance was up during this run (8/8 symbols returned real prices). LIVE badge and tiles rendered.
